en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 3:30 p.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said a few squally thunderstorms are expected over the territory this afternoon under an active southerly airstream.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory extended the Thunderstorm Warning until 3:30 p.m. on Wednesday, after earlier extensions through the morning and early afternoon.
The warning was first issued at 5:20 a.m. The Observatory said a few squally thunderstorms are expected over Hong Kong under the influence of an active southerly airstream.

Members of the public are advised to seek safe shelter if outdoors, leave the water, avoid outdoor swimming or water sports, and keep away from high ground and conductive objects when thunderstorms occur.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至下午3時30分
zh.dek: 天文台表示受活躍偏南氣流影響，預料本港今午有幾陣狂風雷暴。
body: 香港天文台將雷暴警告延長至星期三下午3時30分，早前已多次延長有效時間。
警告於今晨5時20分發出。天文台表示，受活躍偏南氣流影響，預料本港有幾陣狂風雷暴。
市民如身處室外應盡快到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿進行戶外游泳或其他水上活動，並避免站在高地或接近導電物體。
